extracted_concepts.name: Second-Order Linear ODE
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Linear ODE of the form ay'' + by' + cy = 0 or with forcing.

extracted_concepts.name: Ordinary Differential Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differential equation involving one independent variable.

extracted_concepts.name: Partial Differential Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differential equation involving functions of multiple variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Homogeneous Equation with Constant Coefficients
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ay'' + by' + cy = 0 with constant coefficients.

extracted_concepts.name: Characteristic Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ar² + br + c = 0 associated with a constant-coefficient ODE.

extracted_concepts.name: Distinct Real Roots
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where the characteristic equation has two different real roots.

extracted_concepts.name: Repeated Root
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where the characteristic equation has one repeated root.

extracted_concepts.name: Complex Conjugate Roots
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where the characteristic equation has complex conjugate roots.

extracted_concepts.name: Nonhomogeneous Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Second-order linear ODE with a nonzero forcing term f(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Method of Undetermined Coefficients
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Guesses a particular solution based on the form of f(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Variation of Parameters
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Constructs y* = u₁y₁ + u₂y₂ by solving for u₁', u₂'.

extracted_concepts.name: Spring-Mass System
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mechanical system modeled by mx'' + cx' + kx = F(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Undamped Motion
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Spring-mass motion without damping, giving simple harmonic motion.

extracted_concepts.name: Damped Motion
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Spring-mass motion with damping, giving exponential decay.

extracted_concepts.name: Forced Motion
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Spring-mass motion driven by an external force F(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Resonance
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Large response when driving frequency is near natural frequency.

extracted_concepts.name: RLC Circuit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Circuit modeled by LQ'' + RQ' + Q/C = E(t), analogous to spring-mass.

extracted_concepts.name: First-Order System
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: System of ODEs written as x' = Ax.

extracted_concepts.name: Coefficient Matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix A in the system x' = Ax.

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvalue
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Scalar λ associated with a matrix A.

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vector v associated with an eigenvalue λ of A.

extracted_concepts.name: Qualitative Behavior
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Long-term solution behavior such as nodes, spirals, saddles, centers.

extracted_concepts.name: Stable Node
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A qualitative behavior where solutions approach a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Spiral
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A qualitative behavior with rotating solution trajectories.

extracted_concepts.name: Wave Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u_tt = c²u_xx, modeling vibration, sound, and light.

extracted_concepts.name: Heat Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u_t = k u_xx, modeling diffusion and temperature.

extracted_concepts.name: Laplace Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: u_xx + u_yy = 0, modeling steady-state and potential problems.

extracted_concepts.name: Separation of Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Assumes u(x,t) = X(x)T(t) to reduce a PDE to ODEs.

extracted_concepts.name: Fourier Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Series expansion using sine and cosine terms.

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenfunctions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions arising from separation of variables that form orthogonal systems.
